{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'severe' in severity column
severe_present = 'severe' in df['severity'].unique()

# Check if severity column has any non-null values
severity_has_data = df['severity'].notna().all()

# Report findings
print(f"'severe' in severity levels: {severe_present}")
print(f"severity column has valid data: {severity_has_data}")

# Also check the unique values in severity
print(f"Unique severity levels: {df['severity'].unique()}")"}
